name: Gunther's Spellbook
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Bethor's enchantment marks Gunther's Spellbook. The tome may show its owner that other mages have escaped the Lich King's control.

sections.title: A Token of Old Kinship
sections.body:
Gunther Arcanus once studied magic in Dalaran with Bethor Iceshard and Thule Ravenclaw. All three were Kirin Tor members. When the Plague of Undeath swept Lordaeron, Gunther fell and rose again as one of the undead. In time, he broke free of the Scourge's hold on his mind.

Gunther believed he stood alone and that the Lich King's agents hunted him. So he grew deeply hostile to outsiders. After the tome was recovered, Bethor laid an arcane enchantment across its pages. Bethor's signature marks the magic, so Gunther can recognize his old companion's presence and learn another mage has kept his own will.

faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus owns the spellbook and lives on an isolated island in Brightwater Lake, in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why did Bethor enchant the spellbook?
faq.answer: Bethor placed a personal spell on the tome to prove he survives in Lordaeron and has escaped the Lich King's control. He hopes Gunther will believe him and ally with the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why is Gunther suspicious when the book is returned?
faq.answer: Gunther believes anyone who approaches his retreat may be a Scourge agent sent to enslave him again. At first, he thinks you are only the thief who took his tome.

faq.q: How did Gunther and Bethor know each other?
faq.answer: Before the Plague, Gunther, Bethor Iceshard, and Thule Ravenclaw studied magic together in Dalaran. They were friends and Kirin Tor apprentices.

angles.text: As a mage, you share Dalaran's arcane roots with the Forsaken's magical leaders and with practitioners who roam the wilderness alone.
As an undead, you know the Forsaken seek powerful undead who have freed themselves from the Lich King's control.
